body:
EVALUATION IS TEMPORARILY OFF UNTIL EXECUTION OBSERVABILITY IS IMPLEMENTED. The full rule is in rules-greg-control (revision 25, section 3).

Greg, verbatim, all in session-5135 unless noted:
- "EWALUACJA jest tymczasowo wylaczona do czasu implementacji Execution Observability" (2026-11-02);
- "NIE USUWAMY EWALUACJI Z KODU czy z dokumentow";
- "THIS SHIT IS TURNED OFF UNTIL WE GOT THIS WORKING" (Architect3 #308);
- "that should be already a fucking rule in engram memory".

In practice:
- No landing, completion or other work waits for an independent acceptance evaluation, and nobody asks Greg about one.
- Enforcement is off in the policy of both stores (epoch 3, allowed_modes=[]). Don't turn it back on until Execution Observability works.
- The evaluation code and docs stay.
- A missing verdict stays missing and is never recorded as a pass.
- Still required: full gate, clean review pair, criterion evidence, migration rules, and Greg-only TermAl restarts.
